title: hilldiv3 manuscript: Microflora Danica worked example (data and webbook)
description: Data, analysis code and rendered webbook for the Microflora Danica worked example in the hilldiv3 manuscript: a genome-by-sample abundance table for 5,518 representative MAGs across 360 samples, sample and genome metadata, a phylogenetic tree, KEGG-derived functional traits, and R Markdown chapters that run neutral, phylogenetic and functional Hill-number analyses with hilldiv3. Source data derive from the Microflora Danica deposit (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17162544).
